submitted.rationale: Photocurrent rises steeply with V content: V0.55 gave 7e-8 A, V0.67 (near ZrV2O7) gave 8.4e-7 A, and V0.88 gave 3.73e-6 A. That fits V2O5-like absorption and transport dominating at 3.22 eV. Index 10 is the most V-rich candidate in the library and had the highest measured photocurrent.

rejected.reason: Measured 8.4e-7 A, about 4x lower than index 10. The ZrV2O7-stoichiometry region does not outperform the V-rich end.
Measured 7e-8 A. Near-equimolar V-Zr is poor.
Not measured. The trend shows photocurrent falling as Zr increases, and ZrO2 does not absorb at 3.22 eV.
